g.text: Figure 1 | Preserving meaning from expert responses to grouped claims.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: a, Coverage and faithfulness before grouping (purple) and after grouping (orange), shown for the same 320 simulated consultations. Coverage measures how much

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: original claim content is retained; faithfulness measures whether the resulting claims preserve the source meaning. Both maps have equal x–y scaling,

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: identical 0–100% axes and common density normalisation; the corner diamond marks complete, faithful retention. Contours enclose 50% and 90% of each estimated

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: density; marginal curves show each metric separately. The grouping changes are constructed illustrations, not measured effects. b, Saved assistant-pilot

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: retention across four synthetic scenarios (six panels and 55 reference-claim occurrences per scenario). Purple marks full preservation, amber adds partial

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: preservation, and the pale remainder represents omissions. Judgments were unblinded self-review; all omissions reflect the eight-claim cap. c, Illustrative

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: retention distributions for four information types, using a separate 120 simulated cases per type. Faint points show individual cases; prominent dots and

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58

g.text: horizontal segments show medians and interquartile ranges, not confidence intervals. These panels do not establish a measured grouping effect or

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #514b58
